# BAD-022 — Make the CI smoke job a required check once it has run green

## Brief
Branch protection on BadTakes main requires only the Gate check, so the new ci.yml smoke job (BAD-009) reports a red run on a PR without blocking the merge; Spud's landing waits only for required checks, so a broken app boot would still land. ci.yml is path-filtered, which is why Gate exists: requiring smoke directly would strand docs-only PRs, so the change needs either a required check that tolerates a skipped job or a Gate that needs smoke.

Evidence: gh api repos/0snug0/BadTakes/branches/main/protection/required_status_checks -> contexts: [Gate]; gate.yml has no needs: and its header explains why filtered checks cannot be required.
